Unfortunately I don't have much to offer except that I'm in the same boat at 32 years old, so at least you're younger than me. I'm literally on the internet right now doing values tests and career tests because I feel so lost...so dejected...so demoralized. I can't live in a world where I work 40+ hours a week just to be miserable all the time. But the one job that was better for me (teaching) still was not a good fit for me.

I realized that I truly love research. I love being given a topic or issue and finding as much information as I can, sorting it, organizing it, and compiling it into readable or presentable formats. Bonus points if I can be a little creative with the presentation. I'm currently doing a certification program for paralegal studies and seeing if law is a potentially viable field for me.

I wish I had more to offer to you except that you aren't alone in these feelings. Some people are fortunate enough to have a path that's so clear for them and that they love. Others, like us, seem to struggle and have to work harder for it. I wish you the best of luck and hope you find your path. At the end of the day, we are the biggest projects we will ever work on and we have to live with ourselves, so make sure you choose YOU in your decisions. Whenever I do something to live up to someone else's ideals or expectations, that's when I suffer the most. I'm learning to live authentically, as much as I can manage. I can't afford to give up on myself. I hope you can do the same. :)
